explication: This repository curates and publishes a categorized Claude Code resource list. The principal workflow is: a contributor or maintainer submits resource metadata, the issue-form parser validates it against configured categories and existing catalog entries, approved data is appended or edited in the canonical CSV, and README.md is regenerated with formatted entries and badges. A parallel discovery workflow fetches GitHub repository metrics, filters them, and renders ticker SVGs. The graph reflects sampled runtime code and explicit module documentation; GitHub workflow wiring is only represented where source comments establish it.
